entries.1a1e805752a03376: It has its head office in Shinmachi, Nishi-ku, Osaka, and also has a headquarters in Tokyo. With the company at its core, it conducts export and import of various products and domestic trade, and also manufactures and sells products and provides services. It has 106 affiliated companies (84 subsidiaries and 22 associates), of which 75 are [[term:consolidated-subsidiary|consolidated subsidiaries]] and 17 are equity-method affiliates. It has about 100 locations in about 30 countries and regions worldwide. Its business is divided into five reportable [[term:segment|segments]]: Functional Materials, Processed Materials, Electronics & Energy, Mobility and Life-Related.

entries.1f9a504438faac68: The new medium-term management plan 'Walk the Talk 2028' for fiscal 2026 through fiscal 2028 is positioned as building the foundation for dramatic growth. Its basic policies are three: executing growth strategies, developing 'people', and building resilience. In its growth strategy, it will integrate the three reportable segments of Functional Materials, Processed Materials and Mobility into 'Materials', rename Electronics & Energy as 'Electronics', and rename Life-Related as 'Life Science'. It will focus capital allocation on the highly profitable Electronics and Life Science, divide its business portfolio into three areas, 'Growth', 'Focus' and 'Challenge', and says it will continue to reorganize and improve unprofitable businesses.

entries.346d6b34acd4ed91: This business provides engineering plastics, general-purpose plastics, packaging materials and other products to industries such as plastic compounds, masterbatches, resin raw materials and molded resin products, home appliances and OA equipment, electronics, packaging materials, daily necessities, household goods, and civil engineering and construction materials. In the value chain, it is positioned at the stage after upstream "Functional Materials." Sales to external customers in the fiscal year ended March 2026 were ¥206,690 million (down 1.9% from the previous year). By region based on location, Greater China was ¥92,719 million, Asean was ¥67,740 million and Japan was ¥37,173 million. Sales of resins for the electrical and electronics industry, including OA equipment, decreased, but at Nagase Rutakku, sales of industrial hoses and civil engineering pipes increased. Under the new medium-term management plan "Walk the Talk 2028," it is planned to be integrated into the "Materials" segment together with Functional Materials and Mobility.
entries.39987041bacb8c7c: This business supplies resin raw materials, solvents, pigments, dyes, various additives, high-purity chemicals, enzymes and other products to industries including paints and inks, pigments and additives, resins, urethane foam, surfactants, electronics chemicals, water treatment, functional films and sheets, and hygiene materials. It is positioned at the most upstream point of the value chain. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥153,642 million (down 0.1% year on year). By region based on location, Japan is the largest at ¥72,214 million, followed by ASEAN at ¥33,547 million and Greater China at ¥22,031 million. Sales of paint raw materials declined as demand for automotive and construction use fell, while sales of raw materials for semiconductor materials increased. Under the new medium-term management plan "Walk the Talk 2028", the company plans to integrate this business into the "Materials" segment together with functional materials and processed materials.

Revenue from external customers in the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥172,891 million (up 7.2% year on year). entries.96ed934f9e9401d0: This business provides pharmaceutical drug substances and intermediates, in vitro diagnostics, cosmetic raw materials, food ingredients and others to industries such as pharmaceuticals, food and beverages, cosmetics, agriculture, toiletries and healthcare; it is the segment with the largest revenue from external customers among the five reportable segments. Revenue from external customers in the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥309,207 million (up 7.7% year on year). By region based on location, the Americas was the largest at ¥137,508 million, followed by Europe at ¥81,138 million and Japan at ¥77,376 million. The U.S.-based Prinova group expanded market share in food ingredient sales and increased volumes. Sales of cosmetic materials at Nagase Viita were flat. In July 2025, Nagase Diagnostics Co., Ltd., whose predecessor was the diagnostics business division of Asahi Kasei Pharma, began operations and became a consolidated subsidiary. Under the new medium-term management plan 'Walk the Talk 2028', this segment is planned to be renamed 'Life Science'.
entries.9bd0aa1c5ea37238: Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥972,783 million (up 2.9% year on year). Revenue from external customers was ¥309,207 million in Life-Related (up 7.7% year on year), ¥206,690 million in Processed Materials (down 1.9%), ¥172,891 million in Electronics & Energy (up 7.2%), ¥153,642 million in Functional Materials (down 0.1%) and ¥130,256 million in Mobility (down 1.4%), and 'Other', which is not included in the reportable segments, was ¥94 million. By region based on location, Japan was ¥289,441 million (29.8%), Greater China ¥222,166 million (22.8%), the Americas ¥189,297 million (19.5%), ASEAN ¥160,550 million (16.5%), Europe ¥96,469 million (9.9%), and Other ¥14,857 million (1.5%).
entries.a593464defca4598: It combines the 'trading company' function, which uses its global network and its employees' ability to discern information to identify challenges of society and customers and match them with suitable products and solutions, with manufacturing and research functions at its group companies. It handles resin raw materials, solvents, pigments, dyes and various additives in Functional Materials; engineering plastics and packaging materials in Processed Materials; modified epoxy resins, precision polishing materials and semiconductor/electronic device-related equipment in Electronics & Energy; various resins and lightweighting components in Mobility; and pharmaceutical active ingredients and intermediates, in vitro diagnostics and food ingredients in Life-Related. Manufacturing is carried out by consolidated subsidiaries including Nagase ChemteX Corporation, which handles high-performance resins; Nagase Viita Co., Ltd., which handles food raw materials, pharmaceutical raw materials and enzymes; and the Prinova group, which sells, processes and contract-manufactures food ingredients.
